issue.title: Bug: test_route_flow_counter.py xfail for v6 topos overrides pytest_require for is_route_flow_counter_supported

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19813 marks route/test_route_flow_counter.py as xfail for v6 topos.
It overrides pytest_require for is_route_flow_counter_supported. So if we run the test with a SKU that doesn't support route flow counter in a v6 topo, the test will be marked as xfail.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test with a SKU that doesn't support route flow counter in a v6 topo.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should be marked as skipped for SKUs that doesn't support route flow counter.
